snippet.title: BrouHaHa | Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Hear the word. Spell it before time runs out. Keep your rivals from doing the same.

BrouHaHa is an online spelling battle for 2-12 players. Choose from 98 coupons to boost your score, distort your opponents’ audio, disrupt their typing, and reflect their attacks. Survive each round and face your last rival in a sudden-death showdown.

Wishlist BrouHaHa on Steam!
